recal.check: Today: 0.35 % a month and +7.3 %, a lag of 20 months; the candidate: 0.93 % a month and +17.7 %, 18 months.
recal.conclusion: The fitted line (second row) and its longer reading (third) bring the level down but cost accuracy, and the third fell to 5307 in 2022 after the Covid seasons: a slope re-estimated every month makes the factors wobble. Carrying today's smooth mean forward at the drift of the past ten years (last row) brings the candidate's forest Fit to 5639 and its Top to 5780 on 1 October 2026, at almost no cost (today's Top −0.0004, the candidate −0.0005). That is the recommendation for forest; reading the line about 4 months further would bring the Fit to 5600 exactly. In sprint the level is already within 2 % of the target and the corrections only added noise (−0.0020 for today's Top), so sprint keeps today's recalage. The Top stays about 2.5 % above the Fit at the top by construction, since its six places keep the best races; anchoring the factor on the Top rather than the Fit would put the published Top itself at 5600.
